讚美之泉
詞曲：曾祥怡

lines.a: 聖潔耶穌 祢寶座在這裡
lines.b: Jesus, my King, You're seated on the throne

lines.a: 哈利路亞 祢榮耀在這裡
lines.b: Hallelujah, Your glory fills this place

lines.a: 君王就在這裡 我們歡然獻祭
lines.b: Sing, worthy is the King, we offer all our praise

lines.a: 擁戴祢為王 榮耀都歸於祢
lines.b: Crown You Lord of lords, give glory to Your name

lines.a: 君王就在這裡 大能彰顯這地
lines.b: Sing, worthy is the King, You're robed in majesty

lines.a: 和散那歸於至高神主耶穌
lines.b: Hosanna unto the glorious King of kings

lines.a: 更多更多來高舉祢的名
lines.b: Higher and high'r, we lift Your holy name

lines.a: 更多更多來呼喊祢的名
lines.b: Higher and high'r, we lift a shout of praise

lines.a: 更多更多來承認祢是主
lines.b: Louder and louder, declare that You are Lord

lines.a: 直到那日 我再見祢的面
lines.b: Until that day, I see You face to face

lines.b: Higher and high'r, we lift Your holy name
